apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed
- Songs got stuck. When Lidarr couldn't look up a few songs ("Invalid response received from LidarrAPI"), Tuna tried those same songs every 10 seconds and never got to the rest of the list. Now such a song is looked up through MusicBrainz instead; if that fails too, it's tried again in 1, 5 and 30 minutes and then shown as not found, and the songs behind it carry on.
- Soulseek: copies Tuna gave up on no longer stay in slskd's list as "Completed, Cancelled" (and ones earlier versions left there are cleared).

Changed
- Soulseek: someone who refuses to send a song isn't asked again for an hour, for any song, and Tuna asks each person for one song at a time when someone else has it too. Refusals no longer use up a song's tries, and the log says why each one came.

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating.
